newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand sees nine pct rise in 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sees nine pct rise in 1997/98 budget.

text.p: Thailand's 1997/98 budget is set to rise by nine percent to 1.008 trillion baht ($40.3 billion) over this year's revised budget of 925 billion baht, Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Tuesday.
The fiscal 1996/97 budget was earlier set at 984 billion baht. But the government expected revenues to fall from its original target to 925 billion baht due to the current economic slowdown.
However, the government has insisted that the budget this fiscal year will be balanced, meaning it would have to cut expenditures to meet revenues.
